notes.title: Pro Philosopher Fan Argument Competition!
notes.notes: [p]A number of you have expressed interest in Pro Philosopher's arguments and engine, and expressed an interest in being able to make your own arguments for the games. So! We're hosting a little contest. [b]We will make the winner's argument functional in our engine, and released as a free standalone app![/b]  [/p][p]You have until [b]October 2nd[/b] to post your arguments to the fan works section of our official Discord. [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/a9WvnXPZjB" style="button"]Join said Discord Here![/url] [/p][p][url="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1DRH6IyG1XmA3tOaTEIbadteImIpaYkcABn6AlKX7JYg/edit?tab=t.0  "]Here is a template google doc we recommend starting with. [/url]  [/p][p]We will then host a vote on the discord that lasts until [b]October 5th[/b] to choose which one we make!  [/p][p]We estimate the turnaround from voting closing to the release of the app will be around 2 weeks, but ask for some flexibility on that aspect. We may make some small edits while translating it to gameplay if necessary![/p][p][b]CONTENT RESTRICTIONS:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]The total scene must be [b]no longer[/b] than 300 lines, 4000 words, and at max 2 arguments. [/p][/*][*][p]The scene must follow the same rules as our discord (No hate speech, engage ideas in good faith, no porn, etc.) [/p][/*][*][p]The scene can star [b]any characters from Pro Philosopher 1 or 2[/b], knowing they will use the sprites from their original game.   [/p][/*][*][p]The scene [b][i]could[/i][/b] include [b]ONE historical philosopher not from either game[/b], though we will put them in as a cutout with no animations. [/p][/*][*][p][b]No more than 5 total characters![/b] And 5 is pushing it. Each character makes things harder to block. (Don’t talk to me about the finale of 2.)  [/p][/*][*][p]Setting can be wherever, but if not one of the locations in Pro Philosopher 2, the background will be some public domain image![/p][/*][/list][p]This is meant to be fun more than anything -- topics from philosophy to romance are already being plotted on our server. [/p]

notes.title: The Pro Philosopher series is LIVE on Mac!
notes.notes:
Well, we did some final jiggering, pressed a couple more interface buttons, and it's really real: as of a few moments ago [i] both [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2120060/Socrates_Jones_Pro_Philosopher/]Socrates Jones: Pro Philosopher[/url][/i] AND [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2120070/Pro_Philosopher_2_Governments__Grievances/]Pro Philosopher 2: Governments and Grievances[/url][/i] are playable on Macintosh computers!

 Go tell all your Mac friends! And if you ARE a Mac friend, welcome! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42832916/4cd28da91e1df6a9ba95160b5169042c481417c7.png[/img]

[h2]The Complete Collection is Also Live![/h2]

With today's Mac launch, and the release of the Soundtrack for Pro Philosopher 2, we are also creating a new [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46066/Pro_Philosopher_Complete_Collection/]Pro Philosopher Complete Collection[/url][/i] Bundle: the second game, and both soundtracks, for 10% off! Hey, if big AAA studios can do bundles, us small scrappy indies can, too.

If you've enjoyed our strange philosophical venture of ours, it's certainly a good option.

We appreciate each and every one of you: whether you are finding us now, have been with us since the steam launch, or way back since the first cult Flash release in 2013. Here's to many years of Philosophy to come!

notes.title: The Pro Philosopher Series comes to Mac 10/23!
notes.notes:
We've been running a few secret tests behind the scenes and can now confirm, imperically, that the Pro Philosopher series is going to work on Mac! So, [b]this next Wednesday, both [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2120060/Socrates_Jones_Pro_Philosopher/]Socrates Jones: Pro Philosopher[/url][/i] AND [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2120070/Pro_Philosopher_2_Governments__Grievances/]Pro Philosopher 2: Governments and Grievances[/url][/i] will go live on Macintosh computers![/b]

And to whet your appetite, Apple-ites, the Mac version of the [b]Demo for Pro Philosopher 2 is live  [i]RIGHT NOW![/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249403/d4da80177cc6fab5e2af91eb93b4bc62c8821165.jpg[/img]

BUT THAT'S NOT ALL!

This Wednesday will also see the official release of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416130/Pro_Philosopher_2_Soundtrack/][b]Soundtrack for Pro Philosopher 2[/b][/url], both in MP3 and high-quality WAV format. This soundtrack will also contain the notoriously catchy "Who's a Pro Philosopher?" track we made for the trailer of 2!

[previewyoutube=HXIV-PNX0mw;full][/previewyoutube]

We're incredibly proud of this series, and happy with how people have been receiving it. We're excited to be able to bring it to a new platform where, let's be honest, a lot of the word nerds live. Like the Philosophy Professor we worked with in making these games, Andy Norman. 

Your dream is coming true, Andy! You will be able to play the game again!

Happy NONSENSEing,

The Pro Philosopher 2 Team

notes.title: Socrates Jones: Pro Philosopher: Fixes from the Sequel!
notes.notes:
In developing the sequel [i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2120070/Pro_Philosopher_2_Governments__Grievances/]Pro Philosopher 2: Governments and Grievances[/url][/b][/i] (out now!), there were a number of things we learned and improved that we're now back-porting to the original game! Benefits of using (mostly) the same engine! And some of these fixes are pretty significant. Here's the highlights list:
[list]
[*] All our art is using a higher quality compression algorithm! It's subtle, but the game [i]definitely[/i] looks better!
[*] 1, 2, 3, and 4 are shortcuts for the various argument buttons on PC!
[*] Little gaps at the top and bottom of cutscenes (which you hopefully never noticed) are gone!
[*] Saves during notifications will now load correctly!
[*] Fixed an edge case where saves could be strange after a transition!
[/list]

We also made the following script changes to the goofy bonus argument, just for fun:
[list]
[*] We once again updated Ari's game preferences to reflect the new hotness. Though really Ari needs to stop shilling for AAA games. Play more indies, Ari!
[*] We also updated the very end to reflect THAT PRO PHILOSOPHER 2 IS NOW OUT.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42832916/2bb87b48c8d2582fde4d508027cb8a0a6d8c90d8.png[/img]

notes.title: Bonus Content & Future Plans
notes.notes:
It's been a little while since we got the [i]Socrates Jones: Pro Philosopher[/i] remake out the door, and it's been really wonderful to see people enjoy this release— both those who are experiencing it for the first time, and those who've been with us since 2013. This game is a "nights and weekends" labor of love for us, and knowing so many people appreciate our efforts means everything.

But though the game is out now, we're not done yet!

Now, this isn’t going to be a "live service" situation. We're not planning a season pass here— no purchasable hat DLC for Socrates, don’t worry. (If you want to give us money, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2319150/Socrates_Jones_Pro_Philosopher_Soundtrack/?beta=0]buy the soundtrack![/url]) But we DO have a number of exciting things in the pipe, starting with:

[h3]A new Bonus Argument![/h3]
When promoting this game, I wrote a goofy argument where Billy the Salesman tries to convince Socrates to buy [i]Pro Philosopher[/i]. Some chunks of that are in the video on the Steam Page, but...hell, I made an entire functioning argument, and it's just been sitting in my files since. Why not let people play it? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42832916/272f8a9e1dbb2e6872bc241bc150c756f3aab26c.png[/img]

It's not like anyone reading this needs to be convinced to play [i]Pro Philosopher[/i], but I hope you'll still get some enjoyment from it. Maybe you'll make your friends play it, and those friends will be like "Hot damn, I need to see the rest of this." WHO KNOWS!

Regardless, that argument is in-game NOW. Anyone who has finished the game can access it by hitting "Bonus" in the chapter select menu.

[h3]Community Loc Projects![/h3]
We've had a lot of people ask us about [i]Pro Philosopher[/i] in other languages over the years. We'd love to be able to reach as many people as possible, but as a project we're running on the side, that's quite an intimidating proposition for us to take on for ourselves.

But all hope is not lost! Back in 2013, a number of fans stepped up to localize the game into various languages. [b]The implementation of that content is a little further off[/b], but we won't let that effort go to waste, so stay tuned for more information!

(Maybe once the game is in Japanese, Shu Takumi will answer my calls...)

[h3]WAIT! I finished the game and I have questions about that stinger!![/h3]

Yes! Of course you do. And don't worry, those questions will be answered in due time.

We're not QUITE ready to pull back the curtain on everything the scene implies, but needless to say it's where most of our efforts are going right now. Stay tuned to this Steam Page, [url=https://twitter.com/pro_philosopher][b]our twitter[/b][/url] or our [url=https://pro-philosopher.tumblr.com/][b]tumblr[/b][/url], and you'll hear when we have more to share. It shouldn't be too far off now.

Aw, hell, okay. I can give you a little something:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42832916/8dc9f14ca621b48cdce83767d716b2e50c38538c.png[/img]

notes.title: Socrates Jones: Pro Philosopher is LIVE on Steam!
notes.notes:
It's finally here! We've hit the big release button, and [i]Socrates Jones: Pro Philosopher[/i] is available to all!

This release was a labor of love created over years of nights and weekends, with improved UI, improved art, additional gameplay features like achievements and full controller support, and a few new script additions for the eagle-eyed vets...

[i]A loving homage to a certain lawyerly game series, Pro Philosopher introduces its own mechanical twists to cross-examination gameplay, all wrapped up in a charming story and healthy helping of humor. Face off in interactive debates against a host of famous philosophers— and a deer repellent salesman. Ask questions and present counterpoints to find problems in your opponent's ideas and cut through their NONSENSE![/i]

We're very proud of how this new version turned out, and hope you'll enjoy playing it as much as we enjoyed making it!

If you want to follow future developments or get in touch, check us out [b][url=https://twitter.com/pro_philosopher]on twitter[/url][/b] or here on the Steam forums!

Love,
The Pro Philosopher Team
